resources.string:
Make sure to turn off the SMS app\'s notification in system settings to avoid double notifications.

If the SMS app enforces notification permission, you can keep it granted and turn off all notification channels instead.

For SMS, this app takes over SMS notifications, it only filters them, spam messages will still be present in the SMS app.

%s

:
  The regex matches against the caller display name(CNAP).

In the call history log, the caller name will appear after the phone number in parentheses if it exists, like:
  12345 (Display Name)

:
  The regex matches against the number\'s geolocation.

  This relies on Google\'s library libphonenumber, an offline database that provides geographical information for phone numbers.

For example:
  Block numbers from San Francisco, CA with regex san fr.*

Allow local calls from the same region and block others.

Replace Milan with your actual region.

The syntax (?!Milan$).* means:
  Match any text that is not Milan.
